description: Known-answer pairs for the semantic_lint contradiction probe, reconstructed to the specification: 10 clear contradictions, 10 clear compatibles, 10 subtle (temporal qualification, different subject, scope). The originals were never committed; this set replaces them and is versioned so later runs measure the same pairs.
label_meaning: contradicts: both claims cannot be true at once, read the way the production probe instruction defines it
